# YieldNest.online

> Independent Mutual Fund Research & Analytics Platform for Indian Equity & Debt Schemes.

YieldNest.online provides independent, quantitative, data-driven research on Indian Mutual Funds. Our articles analyze 3-year and 5-year rolling returns, downside capture ratios, standard deviation, portfolio overlap, expense ratio (TER) compounding drag, and AMFI India liquidity stress test disclosures.

We are strictly an investor education and quantitative research publication. Not registered with SEBI or AMFI; no financial advisory services, distributor commissions, or solicitation.

## Core Research Articles

- [What Is a Mutual Fund? Complete Guide for Beginners](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/what-is-a-mutual-fund-guide): Understand how mutual funds pool capital in India, the role of SEBI regulations and AMCs, diversification mechanics, and unit allotment via Net Asset Value (NAV).
- [What Is SIP? How Systematic Investment Plans Work](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/what-is-sip-guide): Learn how Systematic Investment Plans (SIP) work in Indian mutual funds, the mathematics of rupee cost averaging, and disciplined automated compounding.
- [What Is NAV in Mutual Funds? Valuation and Calculation Explained](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/what-is-nav-in-mutual-funds): Learn what Net Asset Value (NAV) means in mutual funds, the official SEBI valuation formula, daily cut-off timings, and why a low NAV does not mean a cheaper fund.
- [What Is Total Expense Ratio (TER) and How Does It Affect Returns?](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/what-is-expense-ratio-impact-on-returns): Learn what Total Expense Ratio (TER) is, SEBI regulatory caps across AUM slabs, how it is deducted daily from NAV, and the long-term wealth drag of recurring fees.
- [Direct vs Regular Mutual Funds: Key Differences and Expense Drag](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/direct-vs-regular-mutual-funds-difference): Understand the structural differences between Direct and Regular mutual fund plans in India, broker trail commissions, and the mathematical compounding impact.
- [What Is Exit Load in Mutual Funds? Cut-Off Periods and Calculation](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/what-is-exit-load-in-mutual-funds): Learn how exit loads operate in Indian mutual funds, standard holding periods across categories, exemption thresholds, and calculation on redemption.
- [What Are CAGR and XIRR? How Mutual Fund Returns Are Calculated](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/what-is-cagr-and-xirr-in-mutual-funds): Learn how CAGR and XIRR measure investment returns in Indian mutual funds, the mathematical difference between lump sum and SIP tracking, and when to apply each metric.
- [How to Read a Mutual Fund Factsheet: Key Metrics Every Investor Must Check](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/how-to-read-mutual-fund-factsheet-essential-metrics-guide): Learn how to read an official AMC mutual fund factsheet: AUM, portfolio turnover, risk-adjusted ratios (Sharpe, Sortino, Beta), and benchmark comparison tables.
- [Mutual Fund Capital Gains Tax in India: Equity vs Debt Rules (2026)](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/how-mutual-fund-capital-gains-are-taxed-equity-vs-debt): Complete guide to mutual fund capital gains taxation in India: holding periods, revised Section 112A LTCG tax rates, STCG brackets, and debt fund taxation.

## Quantitative Calculators Suite

- [Quantitative Calculators Hub](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators): Interactive suite of mathematical tools for Indian mutual fund investors.

- [Step-Up SIP Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/step-up-sip): Annual top-up compounding simulator linked to appraisal increments.
- [Lumpsum Investment Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/lumpsum): One-time mutual fund compounding and tax calculator.
- [SWP Longevity Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/swp): Systematic Withdrawal Plan monthly cash flow and corpus depletion model.
- [Goal Planner Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/goal-planner): Inflation-adjusted target cost and required monthly SIP calculator.
- [Capital Gains Tax Estimator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/tax-estimator): Equity LTCG, STCG, Section 112A exemption, and debt taxation calculator.
- [Direct vs Regular Plan Fee Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/direct-vs-regular): Measure wealth lost to distributor commissions and TER drag over 10-30 years.
- [Cost of Delay Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/cost-of-delay): Compound interest penalty of waiting 6 months, 1 year, or 2 years to start an SIP.
- [SIP vs Lumpsum Comparator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/sip-vs-lumpsum): Strategy comparator evaluating rupee-cost averaging against upfront capital deployment.
